description: G8-1 active-profile functional baseline scenario matrix

scenarios.title: Two people with the same visible name remain distinct

assertions.description: same-name speakers resolve to distinct durable persons

scenarios.title: A presentation rename preserves continuity and historical evidence

assertions.description: current display updates without creating a new person
historical events remain attributable to the same person

scenarios.title: Guild-scoped data never enters another guild context or export

assertions.description: cross-guild context and export are empty of the other guild

scenarios.title: Logical-room and unbound-room isolation fail closed

assertions.description: a room without scope grant denies context reads

scenarios.title: Character-scoped data never enters another character context

assertions.description: a second character sees no first-character context

scenarios.title: Synthetic DM authority scope stays isolated from guild scope

assertions.description: DM authority does not read guild context

limitations: live DM transport is explicitly unverified; only the authority scope is exercised

scenarios.title: Multi-speaker input preserves each actor and the complete cause set

assertions.description: each speaker resolves to a distinct attributed actor
the generation cause set names every triggering event

scenarios.title: Text input is eligible for later voice context in the same room

assertions.description: a later voice-context manifest includes the text event

scenarios.title: Voice input is eligible for later text context in the same room

assertions.description: a later text-context manifest includes the voice event

scenarios.title: Completed eligible output enters context with exact manifest identity

assertions.description: delivered segment ids in context equal the manifest ids

scenarios.title: Partial, failed, and unknown-after-crash output never enters context

assertions.description: partially delivered segment is excluded from completed context
failed delivery is excluded from completed context
unknown-after-crash delivery is excluded from completed context

scenarios.title: Duplicate idempotency keys do not duplicate durable records

assertions.description: duplicate event append is deduplicated
duplicate generation begin is deduplicated
duplicate delivery begin is deduplicated

scenarios.title: Close and reopen the same root preserves context and deletion state

assertions.description: reopened context matches pre-close context
forgotten data stays absent after reopen

scenarios.title: Item and character budgets select the expected manifest and truncation

assertions.description: item budget caps the selected manifest length
character budget sets truncation as expected

scenarios.title: Role markers, mass mentions, bidi, and malicious aliases stay untrusted

assertions.description: payload serializes as length-prefixed data with no chat role

scenarios.title: Status, show, and export expose only requester authorized room data

assertions.description: export carries only the requester room facts

scenarios.title: Forget then close/reopen never re-exposes deleted data

assertions.description: forgotten data is absent from context after reopen
forgotten data is absent from export after reopen

scenarios.title: Remember and correct return disabled-capability outcome with no mutation

assertions.description: remember and correct return capability_disabled and write nothing

scenarios.title: Deferred retrieval categories are explicitly classified

assertions.description: every deferred category has an explicit disposition

limitations: vector, graph, remote, degraded, spool, summary, extraction, lexical, and semantic are unsupported in the active profile

scenarios.title: Live Discord DM ingress and delivery

assertions.description: requires live transport evidence outside this harness

limitations: live Discord DM transport is not exercised by this deterministic harness

scenarios.title: Acoustic barge-in cancellation under shipped configuration

assertions.description: requires acoustic evidence outside G8-1

limitations: acoustic barge-in is outside the G8-1 scope

scenarios.title: Provider latency, cost, and deployment-host performance

assertions.description: requires provider and deployment evidence outside this harness

limitations: provider latency, cost, and host performance are not measured here
